behaviors_asserted: Hono instances should expose a listen function to start a server.
listen starts the server by calling @hono/node-server serve with fetch, port, and hostname.
listen accepts an options object { port?, hostname? } and an optional listener(info) callback.
When port is unspecified, listen defaults port to 3000.
When hostname is unspecified, listen defaults hostname to '0.0.0.0' and the listener callback receives an info object with properties address, family, and port.
